name: Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The stable-compression lower bound applies directly; properness and labeled reconstruction are additional restrictions.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star.
witness_verification: For the full n-cube, proper stable labeled compression is n while \(\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}=\lceil n/2\rceil\), so the inequality is strict for every \(n\ge3\).
